label: Uneasy
summary: The Iran war and the Yemen front still shape the day. Houthi attacks killed 58 recruits, and Saudi Arabia cancelled its flagship 'Davos in the Desert' investment forum. In Sudan, about 160 people were reported killed as drone attacks escalated. The UN food agency said it will cut aid to 500,000 people in Gaza. Torrential rain killed four people in eastern Spain, and the EU faces a €70 billion gap in funding for Ukraine. In Australia, a car attack left an independent MP critically injured. There was also good news. Japan launched a mission to bring back samples from Mars' moon Phobos, and Brazil ended its six-day workweek by constitutional amendment. Mozambique protected a forest that is home to 200 species. Trump said he was open to a three-way summit with Putin and Xi. The weighted formula gave 40; no editorial adjustment.
